project_info.name: SentinelMar - Maritime Oil-Spill Detection & Vessel Correlation Decision-Support System
project_info.target_audience: Maritime Safety Authorities, Coast Guard Officers, Marine Environmental Analysts

tech_stack.frontend: React (JSX/JS), Tailwind CSS, Leaflet / React-Leaflet, Lucide Icons, Recharts, Shadcn UI primitives, Sonner

theme_and_colors.recommended_theme: Dark Command Center Mode (Default) with subtle light high-contrast alternative mode option
theme_and_colors.color_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7 & 4 (Tactical Marine Command & High-Contrast Swiss Intelligence)

layout_and_spacing.structure: Density Grid Mode B (Operations Command Dashboard)
layout_and_spacing.nav_bar: Sticky top bar with tactical status indicator, live UTC clock, active spill counters, search bar, and view toggle
layout_and_spacing.map_view: Interactive full-height Leaflet viewport with custom dark tile basemap layer, spill polygon overlays, vessel AIS trajectory vectors, and corridor radiuses
layout_and_spacing.side_panels: Collapsible dual-side command panels (Left: Cases & Ingestion, Right: Candidate Analysis & Audit Timeline)
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, gap-4, gap-6 (Tight, dense layout maximizing data correlation per pixel without visual crowding)

geospatial_leaflet_guidelines.map_tiles: CartoDB Dark Matter / Esri Dark Gray Canvas or OpenStreetMap with CSS dark inversion filter

candidate_vessel_markers.rank_1_top_suspect: Pulsing red radar icon with heading direction arrow
candidate_vessel_markers.secondary_candidates: Amber/Cyan directional markers with popup telemetry details

key_views_and_features.name: Spill Surveillance Dashboard
components: High-level KPI metrics bar (Total Detections, High-Confidence Alerts, Pending Review, Confirmed Spills)
Cases table list with sortable columns, confidence score bands (0-100%), and status tags
Quick filter options (Timeframe, Corridor Size, Confidence, Status)

key_views_and_features.name: Interactive Case Detail & Correlation Workspace
components: Split view: Synchronized Leaflet Map + Candidate Ranking Matrix
Ranked candidate vessels table with transparent factor breakdowns (Spatial distance, Time gap, Track continuity, Heading consistency, Drift plausibility, AIS reliability)
Interactive slider for SAR time window scrubbing

key_views_and_features.name: Analyst Evidence & Review Console
components: Decision submission form (Confirm / Reject / Needs More Data) with standardized IMO/MARPOL reason codes
Auditable timeline log of analyst annotations, evidence extractions, and state transitions
Export bundle trigger (GeoJSON / Legal Evidence Package PDF/JSON)

key_views_and_features.name: Satellite Scene Ingestion & Batch AIS Upload
components: SAR Scene Register form with GeoJSON polygon editor/dropzone
Batch AIS Position CSV/JSON upload drag-and-drop
Corridor parameter configuration (Search distance nautical miles, temporal window hrs, drift factors)
Real-time processing job execution log stream

data_testid_conventions.rule: Every interactive element, tab, button, input, status badge, map control, and data table row MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use standard .js or .jsx extension since typescript syntax isn't active in this setup.
Import Lucide icons for tactical indicators (Radar, ShieldAlert, Navigation, Layers, Clock, FileCheck, Anchor, Satellite, Activity, Download).
Always provide realistic mock fallback data for satellite spill polygons, AIS trajectories, vessel candidates, score breakdowns, and audit timelines if API is idle.
Ensure Leaflet maps render reliably with react-leaflet or vanilla leaflet. Handle resize events so map container populates full spatial boundaries.
Use Sonner for user toasts on action submissions (e.g., analyst review saved, scene registered, correlation job launched).
Explicitly set text colors on hover/focus states to avoid low-contrast inheritance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered white layouts. Maintain the dark tactical command-center theme throughout.
Include high-contrast data visual badges and progress bars for confidence score breakdowns.
Never use raw transparent header/modal backgrounds that bleed text onto map canvas; always use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque dark slate fills.
Make sure all interactive elements feature data-testid attributes for E2E automated testing.
Provide clear clear disclaimers that output offers ranked vessel candidates for decision support, not legal conclusions.
